secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for the 'Noa AI' server-side insight generation. Get it from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Without it, the app boots fine but AI insights fall back to local heuristics.

secrets.name: SHEETS_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Google Apps Script Web App URL for syncing order statuses back to the 'דשבורד_הזמנות' Google Sheet. Optional — without it, status updates stay in-memory only.
